text:
Asha: Hey team — proposal: run a webinar "From prototype to production: choosing the right inference deployment (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)". Audience: ML engineers, platform, engineering managers. Need speakers, short abstract, run-of-show, and rehearsal plan.

Liam: Love it. I can own registration + HubSpot + GA tracking. :+1:

Sofia: Ill take the product narrative  tradeoffs + a decision checklist. Will draft the abstract and landing copy.

Carlos: Runtime demo sounds good. Ill do autoscaling, routing fallback, and perf/cost snapshot. Prefer prerecorded demo segments with a short live console handoff to avoid demo flakiness.

Jules: I can try to secure a short BrightLeaf customer clip (6-8m). Legal previously okayed clips; will confirm and get them a guidance doc.

Asha: Proposing May 20 at 10am PT (EMEA-friendly). Which dates work? Goal: 300 regs, ~90 live attendees.

Sofia: May 20 works for me.

Carlos: May 20 good.

Jules: Works.

Asha: Locked May 20. Liam please set HubSpot form once copy is final. Who writes landing page copy?

Liam: I can wire the CTA and UTMs: utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=inference_deployments. Sofia + I should pair on the landing copy.

Sofia: Draft abstract (short): "Teams building LLM features face three inference deployment choices: Hosted for speed, Dedicated for throughput predictability, and Private for compliance. Join product and runtime engineers for a practical decision checklist, a demo of traffic routing and autoscaling, and a customer case study on cost/latency tradeoffs."

Asha: Nice. Can you also provide a 1-line elevator blurb and two-line social post?

Sofia: Elevator: "How to pick the right inference deployment for production LLMs  tradeoffs, demos, and a customer story." Social (2-line): "Join Redwood Inference on May 20 to learn when to choose Hosted, Dedicated, or Private deployments for LLMs. Product + runtime engineers share a checklist, demo, and customer examples. Register -> [link]"

Carlos: Demo plan: prerecorded segments (I'll send mp4s) + live console fallback. We should include a simulated failover where Hosted -> Dedicated fallback occurs, and a perf vs cost table snapshot.

Asha: Agreed. Prerecorded demo + live switch if needed. Show a quick failover scenario.

Jules: Customer clip plan: 6-8 minutes focused on why they picked Dedicated and the business outcomes. I'll provide a question guide for them to record.

Carlos: Timeline for assets: demo videos + transcript by May 8; customer clip by May 10; slide deck by May 13 for QA.

Liam: Ops: I can run Zoom, handle recording, stream keys, and calendar invites. Need deck by May 13. Ill create the HubSpot form and embed the registration CTA.

Sofia: Deck guidance: max ~12 slides, use public keynote template in MKTG/Slides/Templates, include decision matrix and one demo snapshot slide.

Carlos: Ill record demo segments and include a short transcript for accessibility. Expect to share mp4 + SRT.

Jules: BrightLeaf to deliver clip by May 10. Ill coordinate legal sign-off and send them the question guide.

Asha: Run-of-show draft: 
00:00-02:00  Asha: Welcome + outcomes
02:00-12:00  Sofia: Product decision checklist
12:00-28:00  Carlos: Demo (recorded segments + live console handoff)
28:00-36:00  Jules + BrightLeaf clip (customer story)
36:00-50:00  Panel Q&A (all speakers)
50:00-55:00  CTAs, resources, close

Asha: Well keep it to 55 minutes so folks can join meetings afterward. Deck should be tight.

Liam: Ill set up calendar invites for two rehearsals: tech check (May 15) and full run-through (May 18). Both 60 minutes. Rehearsal-bot will post reminders 48h and 24h before.

Carlos: Can make both rehearsals.

Sofia: Can make both rehearsals.

Jules: Available for rehearsals.

Asha: Action items: 
- Sofia: landing page copy, abstract, elevator + social blurbs (EOD tomorrow)
- Carlos: demo mp4s + transcript (by May 8)
- Jules: customer clip & question guide (by May 10)
- Liam: HubSpot form, Zoom ops, calendar invites, stream keys + rehearsal reminders
- Asha: finalize run-of-show and marketing checklist

Liam: Noted. Will add UTMs to links and confirm GA event tags.

Asha: Thanks everyone. Once Sofia posts copy well reconvene. :rocket:
